title: Supervised Neural Topic Modeling with Label Alignment
venue: Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics, vol. 13
subcategory: supervised neural topic model with optimal transport
task: Learning topics explicitly aligned with document labels
problem: Supervised NTMs use a label-free prior, so topics blend several labels and label-topic relations are not explicit.
architecture: LANTM: chain-structured VAE graphical model with a label-conditioned prior; soft label-topic indicators obtained as the transport plan of an entropy-regularised optimal-transport problem between label and topic embeddings; reconstruction of label-specific pseudo-documents; plugs into ETM or ECRTM.
key_results: 20NG, K = 50 (k-means): LANTM+ECRTM ARI 0.370, Purity 0.595, NMI 0.578 vs ECRTM 0.101, 0.423, 0.466 and SCHOLAR 0.040, 0.357, 0.391.
Yahoo, K = 50: LANTM+ECRTM ARI 0.178 vs ECRTM 0.083.
Topic quality maintained but with a coherence-diversity trade-off after adding LANTM.
strengths: Explicit, inspectable label-topic relationships; plug-in for existing VAE-based NTMs.

limitations.text: Coherence-diversity trade-off appears after applying LANTM; sLDA failed to converge on 20NG and Yahoo at K = 100.
Label dependencies are not modelled (future work).
